current_evidence: The checklist says it was consulted on 8 March to 21 April 2025, published in August 2025, and 'operates until August 2027 unless reviewed before then'; searches found no newer Wiltshire list. The Apply-for-planning-permission page could not be fetched (client error) to confirm the live link.

issues.detail: Most non-Full application types are marked '(none)' although the checklist gives them specific requirements. (1) Reserved matters: CIL Form (all), Affordable Housing Details (where the outline requires it), Drainage Details (major and certain small residential schemes), Ecological Assessments/Statement (where details changed or outline requires mitigation), Planning/Compliance Statement (all). (2) Demolition in a conservation area: Ecology Assessments, Planning/Justification Statement (all), Structural or Marketing Report (where the building contributes to the Conservation Area). (3) s73: Planning Statement (all), CIL form (where floorspace changes). (4) Non-material amendment: Planning Statement or Covering Letter (all), Heritage Statement (where heritage assets are affected). (5) Discharge of conditions: Condition Discharge Information Statement (when discharging more than one condition). (6) Lawful development cert (existing): Planning Statement (all).
issues.evidence: Checklist sections 4 and 7-12, e.g. Discharge: 'Condition Discharge Information Statement: All applications discharging more than 1 condition'

issues.detail: Outline has about 22 local requirements in the checklist (Affordable Housing, Agricultural Worker Dwelling Justification, Air Quality, Archaeology, Ecology, Fire Risk and Mitigation Strategy, FRA, Land Contamination, LVA, Lighting, Noise, Odour, Phosphorus and Nitrogen Mitigation, Heads of Terms, Heritage, Surface Water Drainage, Sustainable Energy, Town Centre Impact, Transport, Tree Survey, Viability, Waste Audit), but Grokbot captured only three garbled rows. Householder is missing Ecology Assessments, Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2/3), Heritage Statement (where heritage assets affected), Tree Survey/AIA (trees on or adjoining site) and Parking Plan. Advertisement consent is missing Heritage Statement.
issues.evidence: Section 3 Outline 'Local Requirements' heading; Section 1 Householder lists Ecology, FRA, Heritage Statement, Tree Survey

issues.detail: Full planning local requirements not captured as app-type rows: Agricultural, Forestry or Occupational Worker Dwelling Justification (rural workers' dwellings and removal of occupancy conditions); Fire Risk and Mitigation Strategy (solar farms with BESS and standalone BESS); Odour Assessment (odour affecting residential amenity, e.g. commercial kitchens); Phosphorus and Nitrogen Mitigation (increase in overnight accommodation in the Hampshire Avon, River Test, River Lambourn or Somerset Levels and Moors catchments; captured only as tab_items text); Ecology Assessments and Tree Survey/AIA (captured only under LBC).

Several Full planning rows quote the wrong item's text. (1) 'Fire Statement' quotes the CIL Form trigger ('Community Infrastructure Levy (CIL) Form When required: All applications'); the source requires a Fire Statement for buildings 18 m+ or 7+ storeys with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation. (2) 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' quotes the Landscape and Visual Appraisal text; the checklist has no EIA requirement. (3) 'Flood Risk Assessment' is the fragment 'Floor Plan, Flood Risk Assessment).'; the real trigger is Flood Zones 2/3, larger Zone 1 sites and other listed flood-risk cases. (4) 'Ventilation / Extraction' quotes a reference ('Control of odour and noise from commercial kitchen exhaust systems, (Gibson, 2018)'); the trigger is new restaurants, hot food takeaways and pubs serving hot food. (5) 'Heritage Statement' under Full says 'All applications', which is the LBC trigger (prefixed 'Consent 59'); for Full planning it is required only where heritage assets are affected. (6) 'Planning Obligations / Heads of Terms' quotes self-build text; the trigger is major housing and wherever a legal agreement is needed or offered.
issues.evidence: Full: 'Statement of Heritage Significance/Heritage Statement: Required where heritage assets are affected'; LBC: 'Statement of Heritage Significance/Heritage Statement: All applications.'

issues.detail: Several triggers are incomplete. Transport Assessment is cut to 'Residential development of 100 dwellings.' (source: 100+ dwellings, 1,000 m2+ retail/employment/leisure, waste facilities). Air Quality gives only AQMAs (source also covers large residential schemes and minerals/waste). Land Contamination gives only petrol filling stations/garages (source also covers suspected contaminated brownfield land). Surface Water Drainage gives only major applications (source also covers certain small residential schemes). Lighting gives only floodlighting (source also covers development near homes that could affect amenity). Many excerpts also start with stray headings or page numbers ('Application 33', 'Air Quality - Wiltshire Council', 'Making Better Planning Applications Listed Building Content').
issues.evidence: Full Planning Local Requirements: Transport Assessment, Air Quality, Land Contamination, Surface Water Drainage Strategy, Lighting Assessment

issues.detail: LBC items are placed under Full planning and RM items under Outline. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' and 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' (the Structural and Marketing Report for demolition on structural/economic grounds) come from the Listed Building Consent section, not Full planning. Outline 'Planning Statement' quotes the Reserved Matters item ('matters reserved in the outline planning permission'). Outline 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' carries the Air Quality trigger. The LBC 'Tree Survey' row appears to come from the Householder section; the LBC section does not list a tree survey. About 29 Full planning rows are labelled 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The checklist has an explicit Full Planning section, so the label is misleading, but the placement is mostly right.
issues.evidence: LBC section: 'Schedule of Works and/or Specification of Repairs'; 'Structural and Marketing Report: When demolition is proposed on structural and economic grounds.'

issues.detail: Several rows are not requirements. 'Highways / access details' is just the location plan red-line rule. 'Pre-application advice' is a fragment of the Heads of Terms trigger ('confirmation in pre-application discussions that an agreement will be required'). 'Photographs / Photomontages' is a note about material samples. 'Self-build' is S106/CIL exemption text. 'Minerals / Waste specific statements (county matters)' is actually the Waste Audit (10+ houses) under the wrong heading. In tab_items: the DMPO review boilerplate ('should be reviewed and republished bi-annually...'), 'all supporting information required ... must be provided', the PDF link text ('Local Validation Checklist, from 1 Sept 2025 (PDF, 7 MB)'), and email/postal submission details.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Local forms / checklists' and 'Submission rules' rows

issues.detail: planning.data.gov.uk (entity 20258, entry 2026-10-16) still lists the twelve 2022 per-type checklists (media/5411-5422) as Wiltshire's document URLs. Grokbot correctly used the newer September 2025 combined checklist instead. The workbook date of 2025-08-01 matches 'published in August 2025'; the list takes effect from 1 September 2025.

summary: The link is the current Wiltshire Local Validation Checklist (August 2025, in force from 1 Sept 2025, valid to August 2027). The app-type mapping is poor. Reserved matters, s73, NMA, discharge and demolition are marked '(none)' although they have requirements. Outline and Householder are largely missed, and several Full planning rows carry the wrong item's trigger (Fire Statement = CIL text, Heritage = LBC 'All applications', EIA = LVA text).
